description.en: Used the plain arithmetic average of the two end temperature differences instead of the logarithmic mean, overstating the driving temperature difference.
description.et: Kasutas kahe otsa temperatuurierinevuse lihtsat aritmeetilist keskmist logaritmilise keskmise asemel, ülehinnates liikumapanevat temperatuurierinevust.

description.en: Inverted the ratio inside the logarithm, dividing the second temperature difference by the first instead of the other way round.
description.et: Pööras logaritmi sees oleva suhte ümber, jagades teise temperatuurierinevuse esimesega, selle asemel et teha vastupidi.

description.en: Used the plain difference between the two end temperature differences without dividing by the logarithmic weighting term at all.
description.et: Kasutas kahe otsa temperatuurierinevuse lihtsat vahet, jagamata seda üldse logaritmilise kaaluteguriga.
